generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders.The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPP portals due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in the price schedule in the website itself.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of opening.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall obtain Workmen compensatory insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.
The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.
Bidders should have an independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractor s permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Gates)S, KPC Ltd.,Kargal, Sagara Tq 577421.
The bidder shall upload/submit online duly, signed original copy of Form of Tender and Declaration by Bidder formats under Section 3 of bid document.

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Repair/reconditioning/fabrication of dam gates at any Govt. organizations/PSUs of single order value not less than Rs 5.72 lakhs. In proof of the above, a copy of work done certificate issued from the competent authority & the corresponding work order shall be furnished. (Note: The value of completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years, achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 11.43 Lakhs. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. Note: Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the Financial Year in which the tenders are invited . Note: The above documents shall be uploaded along with other documents, failing/not satisfying the above criteria the tenders are liable for rejection In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement /commencement of the work, his legal heir if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rectification of damaged sill beam seal plate of Radial gates at Linganamakki dam

itemList.description: Cutting grooves, pockets, openings in concrete to specified size carefully without damaging the adjoining area including disposal of debris, cleaning the area, etc., complete with lead upto 50m and all lifts. More than 50 mm upto 100 mm depth from surface

Providing, Fabrication, erection, testing and commissioning of sill beam flat, spacers, anchoring rods etc., with all accessories for spillway including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, bending, aligning, anchoring, welding, finishing, etc., complete as per specifications and approved drawings with all lead and and lifts including packing / forwarding charges for other materials and load testing.
Dismantling existing damaged flat, SS plate at sill beam area and providing , fabrication of new SS plate of 6 mm thick, complete with all lead and lifts

Providing and placing M 30 Polymer concrete/Micro concrete, in spillway sillbeam groove, hard clean approved aggregates. Placing in position, leveling, curing, finishing with steel shuttering and applying a coat of suitable bonding agent just before placing of MC after finishing the concrete surface shall be coated with cement polymer compound to fill the surface pores to get a smooth surface as directed with all lead and lifts etc.,

Alignment and leveling of sill beam uniformly all along the length with suitable leveling instrument and maintain existing level. Lowering the gate element and testing the uniformity, testing and comissioning etc.,

Rewelding of SS to MS (dissimillar material) for wall plate for re strengthening. It includes cost of dissimillar rods, welding machines, chipping, re filling, labours, cutting, grinding, finishing, levelling etc., complete with all lead and lifts
